subject: Vendr SSO proof convergence + temp credential plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: support@vendr.io, lisa.nguyen@acme-corp.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, May 28, 2027 at 4:12 PM PDT
Subject: Vendr SSO proof convergence + temp credential plan

Hi Lisa / Vendr team —

Thanks for agreeing to run the SSO proof and evidence handoff this week. Acme is asking for two things that we need to coordinate across teams: a) a minimal proof package showing SAML metadata + ephemeral service-account evidence for their OneTrust/Vendr integration, and b) short-lived upload credentials for the staging ingest window so their security team can validate proof-of-possession.

Proposed approach (30k foot):
- Day 0 (this thread): agree owners and TTL for temp credentials
- Day 1: Vendr hands over SAML metadata and validation test endpoints (signed response)
- Day 2: Acme runs upload tests using temp creds; we collect logs and sign a possession attestation
- Day 3: Final Q&A in OneTrust portal and close the ticket

As discussed, we want to avoid long-lived keys. Camila — can you own the temp-cred issuance and the log collection? Priyom — please prepare the OneTrust QnA template (I attached a starter). Lisa / Acme — are you comfortable with a 48-hour TTL on the staging credential? If so we’ll generate a presigned S3 upload and a short-lived service account for verification.

Attachments: vendr_tempcred_handbook.pdf (internal ops checklist), onetrust_qna_template.xlsx

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Vendr Support <support@vendr.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, lisa.nguyen@acme-corp.com
Cc: camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, May 28, 2027 at 5:03 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendr SSO proof convergence + temp credential plan

Jonas / Camila / Lisa —

Thanks for the clear plan. We can support a 48-hour TTL for the staging creds and will provide:
- SAML metadata (signed XML) and a test assertion endpoint
- A pre-signed upload URL pattern for S3 with object ACLs and content-type enforcement
- A short proof-of-possession template (we'll fill fields for requestor / upload key / timestamp)

Questions from our side:
1) Which bucket will Acme use for their ingest? (we need the ARN for the presign policy)
2) Do you require KV / audit logs to be included in the evidence bundle (for SOC 2 traceability)?
3) Who will be the named steward for the presign operation on the Acme side (email + phone)?

Camila — we can schedule a 20-min ops call today to provision the creds and test endpoints. We’ll also upload the signed SAML XML to the Vendr evidence portal and share a link once ready.

— Vendr Support
(Attachment: vendr_tempcred_handbook.pdf)
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vendr Support <support@vendr.io>, lisa.nguyen@acme-corp.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, May 29, 2027 at 09:08 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendr SSO proof convergence + temp credential plan

Thanks — quick answers below to unblock provisioning: 

1) Bucket: acme-cloud-proofing-us-west-2 (ARN: arn:aws:s3:::acme-cloud-proofing-us-west-2)
2) Include KV/audit logs in the bundle. We need the upload event + presign request/response recorded for the attestation.
3) Steward: lisa.nguyen@acme-corp.com (cell: +1 415 555 0123).

I can take the provisioning call at 10:00 PT today (20 minutes). Priyom — I’ll need the OneTrust QnA template filled with Redwood’s answers for the SOC 2 sections (CC6, CC7) before EOD so Vendr can attach it for Acme review. Jonas — I’ll also capture the command-line presign example for our ops runbook.

Camila Reyes
Security Integrations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acme-corp.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: support@vendr.io, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 10:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendr SSO proof convergence + temp credential plan

All —

48-hour TTL is fine. We appreciate keeping the keys ephemeral. A couple of notes from Acme Security: 
- Please ensure the presigned URL expires exactly and that we receive a signed proof-of-possession JSON with a timestamp in ISO8601.
- Our OneTrust reviewer asked for CAIQ mappings for the SAML assertions; can Vendr include a short CAIQ mapping doc with the signed metadata?

If Vendr can upload the SAML XML and a CAIQ mapping to the evidence portal, we’ll kick off the OneTrust QnA review immediately after the staging upload. Camila — we’ll be on the provisioning call at 10:00 PT.

Best,
Lisa Nguyen
Security Engineering Manager
Acme Cloud Services
(Attachment: requested_acme_fields.csv)
